This beta view uses RCC-ACIS station observations. The date shown below is the
latest verified station snapshot; a delayed station is marked in the map and
tables rather than silently carried forward.

[Open the station explorer full screen](../stations/index.html){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}

<iframe id="station-explorer-frame" src="../stations/index.html?embedded=1" title="Interactive station conditions map and tables" style="width:100%;height:2200px;border:0;display:block" loading="eager"></iframe>

<script>
(() => {
  const frame = document.getElementById("station-explorer-frame");
  frame.addEventListener("load", () => {
    const body = frame.contentDocument?.body;
    if (!body) return;
    const resize = () => {
      frame.style.height = `${Math.max(800, body.scrollHeight + 12)}px`;
    };
    resize();
    new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(body);
  });
})();
</script>
